## Designed for Australian wealth.

Three commitments behind every screen — and why they're hard to copy.

### Australian tax & SMSF, native

Built from the ground up for AU tax law, SMSF reporting, CGT, and ATO-aligned categorisation. Not a US-built product retrofitted with a kangaroo on the homepage.

### Read-only by design

We aggregate balances through read-only bank APIs. We can see your numbers. We can't move your money. Encrypted at rest, TLS in transit.

### Talk to your wealth

Ask Auravest about your portfolio's tax exposure or rebalancing options like you'd ask a finance-fluent friend. Powered by Gemini, grounded in your own data.
